title: The Extraordinary Watkin Tench
description: 完整答案表、全文段落速覽，以及逐題 Skim、Scan、Read、同義改寫與中伏位分析。

questions.prompt: “There was a great deal of information available about the life of Tench before he arrived in Australia.”
questions.translation: 關於 Tench 到達澳洲前的生活，有大量資料可供了解。

blocks.text: 這是 TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN。題目重點是 “a great deal of information” 和 “before he arrived in Australia”。我們要判斷原文是否支持「資料很多」。
“Apart from his years in Australia, little is known about Tench’s life in Britain.”
除了他在澳洲的歲月外，關於 Tench 在英國的生活，人們所知甚少。
“After his voyage began, however, his life changed dramatically.”
然而，在他的航程開始之後，他的人生發生了劇烈變化。
只看首尾句，可以先猜這段主要講 Tench 到澳洲前的有限背景，以及航程開始後的人生轉折。題目問到達澳洲前資料是否很多，Paragraph 2 第一秒就很有用。
題目中最有定位力的字是：
原文沒有重複 “a great deal”，但有直接相反的表達：
“Apart from his years in Australia, little is known about Tench’s life in Britain.”
除了他在澳洲的歲月外，關於 Tench 在英國的生活，人們所知甚少。
這句的核心是 “little is known”。題目說 “a great deal of information available”，即資料很多；原文說 little is known，即資料很少。這是明確衝突。
a great deal of information= 很多資料little is known= 所知甚少before he arrived in Australia= his life in Britain / apart from his years in Australia判斷：題目說資料很多，原文說資料很少，所以答案是 FALSE。
Paragraph 2 的確提供了不少零散資料，例如出生日期、出生地、父母身份和家庭背景。可是段首明確提醒 “little is known”。IELTS 這類題常把「有一些資料」誇大成「大量資料」。真正控制答案的是程度詞 little 和 a great deal 的相反方向。

questions.prompt: “Tench drew pictures to illustrate different places during the voyage.”
questions.translation: Tench 在航程中畫圖來描繪不同地方。

blocks.text: 這是 TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN。題目有兩個核心：第一，他是否 drew pictures；第二，這些圖是否用來 illustrate different places during the voyage。要小心原文若只說 described landscapes，不能自動推成畫圖。
“During the harsh voyage, which lasted many months, Tench described the landscapes of different places.”
在持續多月的艱苦航程中，Tench 描述了不同地方的景觀。
“As well as making peace with Aboriginal people, Phillip had to reform and discipline the colony’s convicts.”
除了要與 Aboriginal people 建立和平關係外，Phillip 也必須改革並管束殖民地中的 convicts。
只看首尾句，可以先估計 Paragraph 3 從航程中的觀察，轉到到達後的殖民地治理問題。
Question 2 出現 voyage 和 different places，因此先看本段第一句。
“Tench described the landscapes of different places.”
沒有找到： drew pictures illustrations sketches drawings
“During the harsh voyage, which lasted many months, Tench described the landscapes of different places.”
在持續多月的艱苦航程中，Tench 描述了不同地方的景觀。
這句支援 Tench 曾描述不同地方的景觀，但 “described” 可以是文字描寫。原文沒有說他畫圖，也沒有提到 sketches、drawings 或 illustrations。題目加入了 “drew pictures” 這項具體方式，文章沒有提供。
判斷：原文有： Tench described landscapes.原文缺少： Tench drew pictures.這裡沒有明確相反證據說他沒有畫圖，所以不能判 FALSE。資料不足，答案是 NOT GIVEN。
學生容易把 “described landscapes” 理解成「用圖畫描繪風景」。可是 Reading 題要跟文章用字走。describe 只證明他有描述，不足以證明描述方式是 drawing pictures。

questions.prompt: “Other military personnel in New South Wales did not treat convicts in the same way as Tench did.”
questions.translation: 在 New South Wales，其他軍事人員對待 convicts 的方式與 Tench 不同。

blocks.text: 這是 TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN。題目要求比較 Tench 和其他人對 convicts 的 treatment。要找原文是否說 Tench 與上層官員不同，以及他如何對待工人或 convicts。
“From the beginning, Tench stood apart from the other convicts.”
從一開始，Tench 就與其他 convicts 不同。
“On one occasion, he could not carry out Phillip’s order to punish ten Aboriginal people.”
有一次，他無法執行 Phillip 懲罰十名 Aboriginal people 的命令。
只看首尾句，可以估計這段強調 Tench 的特殊性：他與一般 convicts 不同，也在權力、仁慈和道德判斷上與其他官員不同。Question 3 問他對 convicts 的態度是否與其他軍事人員不同， Paragraph 4 是核心段落。
“Yet he also differed from the upper-class officials who governed them.”
“Yet he also differed from the upper-class officials who governed them. He treated the workers humanely, regarding them not as common criminals but as trained military men.”
然而，他也不同於那些統治他們的上層官員。他人道地對待這些工人，把他們看作受過訓練的軍人，而非普通罪犯。

這兩句建立了清楚比較。第一句說 Tench “differed from the upper-class officials”。第二句說他的具體不同：他 humanely 對待 workers，並把他們看作 trained military men。題目的 “Other military personnel” 可對應這些 governing officials；“did not treat convicts in the same way” 對應 “he differed” 和 “treated humanely”。

Other military personnel= upper-class officials who governed them did not treat in the same way= Tench differed from them convicts= workers / convict crew members treated humanely= humane treatment判斷：題目說其他人與 Tench 對待 convicts 的方式不同。原文直接說 Tench differed from governing officials，並指出他的做法較人道。所以答案是 TRUE。
題目用 “military personnel”，原文用 “upper-class officials”。兩者字面不同，但都在殖民地治理架構中與 convicts 有上下級關係。真正要看的是 “differed from” 和 “treated humanely” 這兩個動作訊號。

questions.prompt: “Tench’s view of Aboriginal people remained unchanged during his time in Australia.”
questions.translation: Tench 在澳洲期間對 Aboriginal people 的看法一直沒有改變。

blocks.text: 這是 TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN。題目核心是 “remained unchanged”，即態度是否維持不變。
要找原文是否出現 attitude change。
“When he first arrived, Tench was fearful of and contemptuous towards Aboriginal people because the two cultures did not understand one another.”
Tench 初到時害怕並輕視 Aboriginal people，因為兩種文化互不了解。
“Although violence continued, Tench’s efforts encouraged more peaceful negotiations between the two groups over territory and land use.”
雖然暴力仍然持續，Tench 的努力促使兩群人在領土和土地使用問題上進行更和平的談判。
只看首尾句，可以看到這段從 fear / contempt 走向 peaceful negotiations。題目說 view unchanged，因此 Paragraph 5 很可能提供相反證據。
“Gradually, however, he came to know individuals and became their close friend.”
然而，漸漸地，他開始認識一些個別的人，並成為他們的親密朋友。
這句的 “Gradually” 是重要時間變化詞。它告訴我們 Tench 的態度不是固定不變。他起初 fearful and contemptuous，後來 became their close friend。這是清楚的態度轉變。
“He understood that Aboriginal people would not create conflict if peaceful solutions were sought.”
他明白，如果尋求和平解決方法，Aboriginal people 不會製造衝突。
這句進一步說明他的理解加深。他開始以更具同理心和和平的方式理解 Aboriginal people。
remained unchanged= 沒有改變first arrived: fearful and contemptuous= 起初害怕和輕視gradually became close friend= 後來變得親近和理解判斷：題目說態度沒有改變；原文說他逐漸從害怕輕視變成 close friend。所以答案是 FALSE。
Paragraph 5 末句說 violence continued，學生可能以為關係沒有改善。可是 violence continued是整體衝突仍存在；Tench 個人的 view 明確改變。題目問的是 Tench’s view，不是殖民地整體和平狀況。

questions.prompt: “An Aboriginal person gave Tench gifts of food when they first met.”
questions.translation: Tench 第一次見到一位 Aboriginal person 時，對方給了他食物作禮物。

blocks.text: 這是 TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN。題目有很具體的細節：gifts of food 和 first met。要找原文是否提到第一次見面時有食物交換。
“Much of Australia remained unexplored by the convicts, and even Tench knew little of what lay beyond the established boundaries of the colony.”
對 convicts 來說，澳洲大部分地方仍未被探索；甚至 Tench 也不太知道殖民地既定邊界之外有甚麼。
“There he met an elderly Aboriginal man.”
他在那裡遇到一位年長的 Aboriginal man。
只看首尾句，可以估計這段處理新地點、陌生土地和 Tench 與 Aboriginal people 的接觸。
Question 5 問 first met，所以最後一句很有關聯。
但找不到： food gifts gave offered meal first met with food
“He recalled his first steps on this unfamiliar ground with a boy who helped guide him. There he met an elderly Aboriginal man.”
他回憶自己在這片陌生土地上初次踏步時，有一名男孩幫忙帶路。他在那裡遇到一位年長的Aboriginal man。
原文只說他遇到一位年長 Aboriginal man，也提到一位 boy helped guide him。它沒有說任何Aboriginal person 給 Tench 食物，也沒有說 gifts of food。題目加入了一個很具體的動作和物品，文章沒有支援。
判斷：原文有： Tench met an elderly Aboriginal man.原文缺少： the person gave food / gifts.沒有相反資料說對方沒有給食物，所以答案不是 FALSE。資料不足，答案是 NOT GIVEN。
“first steps” 和 “met an elderly Aboriginal man” 容易讓學生以為原文在描述一次完整的首次接觸場景。可是原文只寫到 meeting，沒有寫 gifts 或 food。遇到這種細節題，要逐項核對動作和物品。

questions.prompt: “The convicts had a good knowledge of Australian geography.”
questions.translation: convicts 對澳洲地理有良好認識。

blocks.text: 這是 TRUE / FALSE / NOT GIVEN。題目核心是 “good knowledge”。要找原文是否說 convicts了解澳洲地理，或剛好相反。
“Meanwhile, many changes were made to the new colony.”
與此同時，新殖民地出現許多變化。
“In reality, thousands of miles of ocean separated the two.”
事實上，兩地之間隔著數千英里的海洋。
只看首尾句，可以估計這段由殖民地變化講到地理誤解。最後一句暗示有人嚴重誤判距離，這與
“good knowledge of Australian geography” 有直接關係。
“The convicts were notoriously ill-informed about Australian geography…”
“The convicts were notoriously ill-informed about Australian geography, as was evident in the attempt by twenty absconders to walk from Sydney to China in 1791…”
convicts 對澳洲地理出了名地無知；這一點可從 1791 年二十名逃跑者試圖從 Sydney 步行到China 看出來。
這句最重要的是 “notoriously ill-informed”。notoriously 指出了名地；ill-informed 指資訊不足、認識差。題目說 good knowledge，原文說 notoriously ill-informed，方向完全相反。
原文還引用逃跑者想法：
“China might be easily reached, being not more than a hundred miles distant, and separated only by a river.”
他們以為中國很容易到達，距離不超過一百英里，而且只隔著一條河。
“In reality, thousands of miles of ocean separated the two.”
事實上，兩地之間隔著數千英里的海洋。
good knowledge= 對地理有良好認識notoriously ill-informed= 出了名地認識不足not more than a hundred miles vs thousands of miles of ocean判斷：題目說 convicts 地理知識良好；原文說他們地理知識非常差，所以答案是 FALSE。
這題的例子非常誇張：Sydney 到 China 被誤以為只隔一條河。看到數字時要留意兩個層次：逃跑者的錯誤想法和作者的 reality correction。答案由 “notoriously ill-informed” 和 “In reality” 定案。

questions.translation: 甚麼證據顯示 Tench 受過良好教育？

blocks.text: 這是 Short-answer Question。題目問 “What evidence”，要找文章中哪個具體線索顯示他 well educated。
“Apart from his years in Australia, little is known about Tench’s life in Britain.”
除了他在澳洲的歲月外，關於 Tench 在英國的生活，人們所知甚少。
“After his voyage began, however, his life changed dramatically.”
然而，在他的航程開始後，他的人生發生了劇烈變化。
只看首尾句，可以先猜這段主要講 Tench 早年資料有限，但中間會提供少量已知背景。題目問education，所以要找 educated / school / English / diaries 相關句子。
“his Australian diaries show that he was well educated”

“Although we do not know exactly how Tench was educated in this small town, his Australian diaries show that he was well educated: they are written in excellent English, a skill not everyone possessed in the 18th century.”
雖然我們不確切知道 Tench 在這個小鎮如何接受教育，但他的澳洲日記顯示他受過良好教育：這些日記以出色英語寫成，而這並非十八世紀每個人都具備的技能。
這句先說 Australian diaries show he was well educated，然後用冒號說明原因：they are written in excellent English。題目問 evidence demonstrates good education，最直接的 evidence 是excellent English。
答案形式檢查： excellent English = 2 words，符合 NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS。
good education= well educated evidence demonstrates= diaries show / written in excellent English
“Australian diaries” 是承載證據的材料；“excellent English” 是證明他受過教育的具體特徵。若題目問 “What showed he was educated?”，diaries 有可能被接受；但這裡問 evidence，較精準答案是 excellent English。

questions.prompt: “For how many years did Tench sign up to serve with the First Fleet?”
questions.translation: Tench 簽約為 First Fleet 服務多少年？

blocks.text: 這是 Short-answer Question。題目問 how many years，所以答案要保留數量和時間單位。
“At the end of the 18th century, life for the average British citizen was changing.”
十八世紀末，普通英國人的生活正在改變。
“When his ship departed in 1788, he signed up for three years’ service with the First Fleet.”
當他的船於 1788 年出發時，他簽約為 First Fleet 服務三年。
只看首尾句，可以看到 Paragraph 1 從英國社會變動引出 Tench 加入 First Fleet。題目問 sign up for how many years，段末句直接提供答案。
“signed up for three years’ service with the First Fleet.”
“When his ship departed in 1788, he signed up for three years’ service with the First Fleet.”
當他的船於 1788 年出發時，他簽約為 First Fleet 服務三年。
題目中的 “For how many years” 對應原文 “three years’ service”。答案要包含時間單位，填 three years 最穩。
答案形式檢查： three years = 2 words，符合 NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER。
sign up to serve= signed up for service for how many years= three years
1788 是出發年份，不是服務年期。題目問 how many years，所以不能填 1788。

questions.prompt: “What was used to control convicts during the voyage?”
questions.translation: 航程中用甚麼控制 convicts？

blocks.text: 這是 Short-answer Question。題目問物件，所以答案應該是名詞。定位詞是 “control convicts during the voyage”。
“From the beginning, Tench stood apart from the other convicts.”
從一開始，Tench 就與其他 convicts 不同。
“On one occasion, he could not carry out Phillip’s order to punish ten Aboriginal people.”
有一次，他無法執行 Phillip 懲罰十名 Aboriginal people 的命令。
只看首尾句，可以估計這段講 Tench 如何與其他人不同，包括他對 convicts 和 Aboriginal people的態度。題目問 control convicts during the voyage，應掃描本段中 Tench 對 convict workers 的處理。
“the chains used to control convicts during the voyage were removed”
“Under his authority, the chains used to control convicts during the voyage were removed.”
在他的權力下，航程中用來控制 convicts 的 chains 被除去。
題目問 “What was used…?”，原文主語短語是 “the chains used to control convicts”。所以答案是chains。
答案形式檢查： chains = 1 word，符合字數限制。
What was used to control convicts= the chains used to control convicts during the voyage= 原文同字重現
題目問的是航程中用來控制 convicts 的物件，不是問 Tench 後來做了甚麼。原文說 chains were removed，removed 是 Tench 的行動；答案仍是 chains。

questions.prompt: “Who gave the order to punish the Aboriginal people?”

blocks.text: 這是 Short-answer Question，問 Who，所以答案應是人名或職銜。定位詞是 order 和 punish Aboriginal people。
“From the beginning, Tench stood apart from the other convicts.”
從一開始，Tench 就與其他 convicts 不同。
“On one occasion, he could not carry out Phillip’s order to punish ten Aboriginal people.”
有一次，他無法執行 Phillip 懲罰十名 Aboriginal people 的命令。
只看首尾句，最後一句已直接包含 order 和 punish Aboriginal people，所以這題可以直接定位到Paragraph 4 段末。
“Phillip’s order to punish ten Aboriginal people”
“On one occasion, he could not carry out Phillip’s order to punish ten Aboriginal people.”
有一次，他無法執行 Phillip 懲罰十名 Aboriginal people 的命令。
這句中，“he” 指 Tench；“Phillip’s order” 表示命令來自 Phillip。前文 Paragraph 3 已介紹：
“Governor Phillip had complete authority over its inhabitants.”
Governor Phillip 對殖民地居民有完全權威。
因此答案可寫成 Governor Phillip，保留職銜更完整。
答案形式檢查： Governor Phillip = 2 words，符合 NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS。
gave the order= Phillip’s order to punish the Aboriginal people= to punish ten Aboriginal people
Tench 是未能執行命令的人；Phillip 是下令者。題目問 Who gave the order，不要把執行者和命令來源混在一起。
這是 Short-answer Question，問 When，所以答案要是時間。定位詞 Hawkesbury River 非常強。
“Meanwhile, many changes were made to the new colony.”
與此同時，新殖民地出現許多變化。
“In reality, thousands of miles of ocean separated the two.”
事實上，兩地之間隔著數千英里的海洋。
只看首尾句，可以估計本段講殖民地變化和地理問題。Hawkesbury River 是地名，應在本段開頭附近找。
“The Hawkesbury River was named by Governor Phillip in June 1789.”
“The Hawkesbury River was named by Governor Phillip in June 1789.”
Hawkesbury River 於 1789 年 6 月由 Governor Phillip 命名。
題目問 When，所以答案是 June 1789。人名 Governor Phillip 只是補充誰命名，不是本題答案。
答案形式檢查： June 1789 = 1 word + 1 number，符合 NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER。
題目沒有問誰命名，所以不能填 Governor Phillip。遇到 Wh-question 要先看問的是 What、Who、When、Where 還是 How many。

questions.prompt: “Where did the escaped convicts plan to go?”
questions.translation: 逃走的 convicts 計劃去哪裡？

blocks.text: 這是 Short-answer Question，問 Where，所以答案應是地點。定位詞 escaped convicts 對應原文 absconders。
“Meanwhile, many changes were made to the new colony.”
與此同時，新殖民地出現許多變化。
“In reality, thousands of miles of ocean separated the two.”
事實上，兩地之間隔著數千英里的海洋。
只看首尾句，可以先知道段末正在糾正某個地理誤解。題目問 escaped convicts plan to go，應看中間 absconders 的例子。
absconders 指逃跑者。原文句子是：
“the attempt by twenty absconders to walk from Sydney to China in 1791”
“The convicts were notoriously ill-informed about Australian geography, as was evident in the attempt by twenty absconders to walk from Sydney to China in 1791…”
convicts 對澳洲地理出了名地無知；這一點可從 1791 年二十名逃跑者試圖從 Sydney 步行到China 看出來。
題目問 escaped convicts plan to go where。原文說 they attempted to walk from Sydney to China。目的地是 China。
答案形式檢查： China = 1 word，符合字數限制。
escaped convicts= absconders planned to go= attempted to walk to答案是 China。
Sydney 是出發地，China 是目的地。題目問 where did they plan to go，所以要填 China，不要填Sydney。

questions.translation: Tench 覺得哪個地方陌生？

blocks.text: 這是 Short-answer Question，問 place，所以答案應是地名。定位詞是 unfamiliar。要找原文中哪個 place 被描述為 strange and unfamiliar。
“Much of Australia remained unexplored by the convicts, and even Tench knew little of what lay beyond the established boundaries of the colony.”
對 convicts 來說，澳洲大部分地方仍未被探索；甚至 Tench 也不太知道殖民地既定邊界之外有甚麼。
“There he met an elderly Aboriginal man.”
他在那裡遇到一位年長的 Aboriginal man。
只看首尾句，可以估計這段講未知地區和陌生接觸。題目中的 unfamiliar 和本段首句的unexplored / knew little 相關，所以 Paragraph 7 是目標段落。
“This second location was strange and unfamiliar…”
要理解 “this second location” 指哪裡，需要回看前一句。
“A few days after arriving at their original location, Botany Bay, the fleet moved to the more suitable Port Jackson, where a settlement was established at Sydney Cove on 26 January 1788.”
抵達原本地點 Botany Bay 幾天後，船隊移往更合適的 Port Jackson，並於 1788 年 1 月 26 日在Sydney Cove 建立定居點。
“This second location was strange and unfamiliar, and the fleet remained alert to anything suspicious.”
這第二個地點既陌生又不熟悉，船隊也對任何可疑情況保持警覺。
這裡 “original location” 是 Botany Bay；船隊移往的第二個地點是 Port Jackson。雖然同一句也提到 Sydney Cove 是 settlement 的具體位置，但 “the fleet moved to the more suitable Port Jackson” 是和 Botany Bay 對照的主要地點，所以答案以 Port Jackson 最穩。
答案形式檢查： Port Jackson = 2 words，符合 NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS。
find unfamiliar= was strange and unfamiliar which place= this second location second location= Port Jackson, after Botany Bay

Sydney Cove 是同一句中較近的地名，因此有一定吸引力。可是從句子結構看，第一個地點是Botany Bay，第二個地點是 Port Jackson；Sydney Cove 是 Port Jackson 內建立 settlement 的具體位置。若考試答案表要求更細地點，Sydney Cove 可能出現，但按 “second location” 的對照關係，Port Jackson 更貼近題目。

paragraphOverview.title: Skim Roadmap：先用首尾句建立全文地圖
paragraphOverview.intro: 先掌握每段的功能與主旨，再進入逐題定位和細讀分析。

paragraphs.summary: 首句說十八世紀末，普通英國人的生活正在改變；末句說 Tench 的船於 1788 年出發，他為 First Fleet 簽下三年服務。只看首尾句，可以估計這段主要交代歷史大背景：人口增長、工業化、失業、犯罪、監獄不足、海外探索和船員需求。Tench 被放在這個社會變動中介紹，重點是他如何成為前往澳洲殖民地旅程的一員。Question 8 的 three years 直接在段末。
首句說除了在澳洲的歲月外，Tench 在英國的生活所知甚少；末句說他的航程開始後，人生劇烈改變。只看首尾句，可以推測這段處理 Tench 的早年背景，但資料有限。中間補充他的出生地、家庭、父母背景，以及教育程度的證據。Question 1 和 Question 7 都在這段：一題問早年資料是否很多，一題問甚麼證明他受過良好教育。

首句說漫長艱苦航程中，Tench 描述了不同地方的景觀；末句說 Phillip 不只要與 Aboriginal people 和平相處，也要改革和管束殖民地的 convicts。首尾句顯示這段先講航程和新環境，再轉入新殖民地的治理難題。Governor Phillip 的權威、開明想法、與 Indigenous peoples 建立和諧關係的意圖，以及 convict crew 缺乏技能，都是此段核心。

首句說從一開始，Tench 就與其他 convicts 不同；末句說他曾無法執行 Phillip 懲罰十名Aboriginal people 的命令。只看首尾句，可以估計這段重點是 Tench 的特殊性：他快速升職，獲得權力，對 convict workers 較人道，也對 Aboriginal people 表現出仁慈。Question 3、9、10 都可在這段定位，因為它同時談 convicts、chains 和 Phillip’s order。

首句說 Tench 初到時害怕並輕視 Aboriginal people，因為兩種文化互不了解；末句說雖然暴力仍持續，Tench 的努力促進了兩群人在土地使用和領土問題上的和平談判。只看首尾句，可以清楚看到態度變化：由 fear and contempt 逐步走向理解和友誼。Question 4 的 “remained unchanged” 正好測試學生有沒有看到這個 gradual change。

首句說新殖民地出現許多變化；末句說事實上，中國與澳洲之間隔著數千英里的海洋。只看首尾句，可以估計這段處理殖民地發展和地理誤解。中間有 Hawkesbury River 命名、殖民者對土地和資源的影響，以及 twenty absconders 誤以為可由 Sydney 步行到 China。Question 6、11、12 都在這段，尤其 ill-informed、June 1789、China 是強定位詞。

首句說大部分澳洲對 convicts 來說仍未被探索，連 Tench 也不知道殖民地邊界之外有甚麼；末句說他在陌生土地上遇到一位年長 Aboriginal man。只看首尾句，可以估計這段講殖民地向外移動和新地點的不熟悉感。Botany Bay、Port Jackson、Sydney Cove 都是重要地名。Question 5 和Question 13 可定位到這段，尤其 first met 和 unfamiliar place。

sourceNotes: Question 13 有一點細節要留意：原文同一句也提到 “Sydney Cove”。如果答案表採用更細位置，可能會見到 Sydney Cove；但按 “original location, Botany Bay” 對照 “the fleet moved to the more suitable Port Jackson”，我會把 “this second location” 理解為 Port Jackson。
